what: A brush-pen-style curve and arrow SVG is drawn once when the top edge of the plate crosses the 80% line of the screen — the first stroke takes 1.2s, the second stroke (the bent arrow tip) starts 1.1s later and takes .8s with cubic-bezier(.43,.05,.17,1) to bring stroke-dashoffset to 0, and the arrowhead slides into place in .5s from 40px to the side and 10px above

options.[data-fx-part=line]: Paths to draw — from the second on, use the second line’s length and delay
options.[data-fx-part=head]: (If present) arrowhead that slides in at the end
options.hook: At what fraction down from the top of the screen the line is drawn when crossed, default .8 (original ScrollMagic triggerHook)
options.--fx-dur / --fx-dur2 / --fx-delay2: First line length, second line length, second line delay (set via style), defaults 1.2s · .8s · 1.1s — they differed per section (1.6s+.3s, 1.2s+.4s, .5s+.3s)
options.--fx-head-x / --fx-head-delay: Horizontal distance and delay for the arrowhead stepping aside, default -40px · .9s

note: The original hangs a ScrollMagic scene on .c-line-animation for each section and adds .action. Here an IntersectionObserver adds it once at the same spot (80%). Line color is currentColor
